_comment: Source registry for PARADIGM INTELLIGENCE. Data, not code.
Each entry: key (unique), adapter ('rss' or 'jsonl'), source_type (trust tier),
publisher, enabled, confidence (0-1, confidence in the SOURCE not the content),
company_hint (set when the feed belongs to one company), and adapter options.
source_type values, highest trust first: COMPANY, GOVERNMENT, PROCUREMENT,
No live feeds are enabled by default. Before enabling one, confirm its terms of
use, rate limits and redistribution rights - this repository makes no claim
about sources that have not been checked. See docs/ROADMAP.md.
The two examples below are disabled templates. Copy, edit, set enabled: true.
